verdict.rationale: The CLI can pull an agent's branches and code changes into the local environment so a developer can continue the work there. A terminal TUI lets you browse agents and view runs. The API can resume paused runs, and Slack lets you message the agent to redirect it. Missing for 10: an explicit hand-off of a live in-progress task to the editor or browser, documented redirect/takeover of a running session (beyond pulling branches), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
